evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: No other story forbids or constrains fingerprint-based discovery in a way that creates an incompatibility; other discovery methods are complementary.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Profile-based discovery does not conflict with other discovery approaches; no story states profile-based discovery must not be used.

evaluations.evidence: based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Similarity-based discovery is compatible with profile-based and fingerprint-based discovery; no contradictory rule exists elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Content-similarity discovery for videos/ringback tones does not impose constraints that contradict other stories.

evaluations.evidence: exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Using metadata/tags for discovery is consistent with other discovery and tagging stories; no incompatible behavior is specified.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Tag availability supports later processing and does not conflict with any story that restricts tag usage or availability.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Viewing thumbnails is compatible with segmentation/annotation/admin workflows; no story prohibits exposing segment thumbnails.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Providing similarity info does not contradict other requirements; perceptual similarity (ZO-009) is an additional capability, not an incompatible one.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Perceptual similarity can coexist with generic similarity info; no story mandates a different or exclusive similarity definition.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Recommendation based on similar profiles is consistent with other recommendation sources (e.g., news events); no exclusivity is stated.

evaluations.evidence: recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Location/news-based recommendations do not conflict with profile-based recommendations; both can be offered.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information
evaluations.rationale: Person identification is compatible with other identification tasks (products/logos/brands) and does not impose contradictory constraints.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos
evaluations.rationale: Product identification does not conflict with person/logo/brand identification; no story restricts identification to only one category.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos
evaluations.rationale: Logo identification is compatible with other identification features; no contradictory permissions or rules are specified.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification can coexist with product/logo/person identification; no incompatibility is stated.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image... recommended with videos related to that picture
evaluations.rationale: Image-based recommendation does not conflict with other recommendation/discovery mechanisms; it is an additional input modality.

evaluations.evidence: access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Map-based access is compatible with search/recommendation features; no story prohibits location-based access.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: ASR-based search is compatible with other search methods; no conflicting constraint exists.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Admin segmentation editing does not conflict with other admin tasks; no story states segmentation must be immutable or uneditable.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Annotation/topic extraction complements segmentation (ZO-019) and does not impose incompatible rules.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Quality-based filtering/ranking is compatible with other prefiltering and validation tasks; no contradictory ranking rule is specified.

evaluations.evidence: quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Detecting prior edits does not conflict with noise removal or other audio processing; it is an assessment capability.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Nudity prefiltering is compatible with other prefiltering/validation steps; no story requires nudity content to be allowed or unfiltered.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Low-level prefiltering is compatible with high-level prefiltering (ZO-026) and other validation tasks; no mutually exclusive rule is stated.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Copyright validation does not conflict with other prefiltering/quality checks; no story mandates skipping such validation.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter... using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Galaxy Zoo preclassification is domain-specific and does not conflict with other domain pipelines; no shared constraint is contradicted.

evaluations.evidence: automatic image series detection... timestamping malfunction
evaluations.rationale: Series detection for timestamp issues does not conflict with animal detection/preclassification; it addresses a different processing concern.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Attribute preclassification complements species and number detection; no incompatible rule is stated.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Number detection is compatible with species/attribute preclassification and empty-image detection; no contradiction is specified.

evaluations.evidence: detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton

evaluations.evidence: automatic detection of plankton size or orientation
evaluations.rationale: Size/orientation detection complements segmentation and species preclassification; no incompatible constraints are stated.

evaluations.evidence: automatic preclassification of plankton species
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification is compatible with size/orientation detection and empty-image detection; no contradiction is specified.

evaluations.evidence: worm motion analysis to reduce video duration

evaluations.evidence: detect the time... where the worm lays an egg

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file

evaluations.evidence: interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video

evaluations.evidence: educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Education modality selection complements education timing (ZO-051) and does not conflict with interruption modality (ZO-050).

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Subject grouping by similarity does not conflict with any other story; no alternative grouping rule is mandated elsewhere.

evaluations.rationale: Project recommendation is compatible with volunteer-type identification and education/interruption logic; no story imposes incompatible recommendation constraints.
